summary.text: Tan Parker, a Republican businessman from Flower Mound, represents Texas Senate District 12 and has served in the Senate since 2023. He chairs the Senate Republican Caucus and the Senate Committee on Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Parker served in the Texas House from 2007 to 2023 and was chosen by his colleagues as chair of the House Republican Caucus during the 84th and 85th legislative sessions.
He graduated from the University of Dallas, earned a master's degree from the London School of Economics, and built a career in technology and private equity.
He and his wife, Beth, live in Flower Mound and have two daughters.
